example_idc_ceiling_first.description: Ceiling value of the single-award IDC in the commenters' first example of orders falling below the ceiling.

example_idc_orders_bound_second.description: Amount that task or delivery orders under the single-award IDC in the commenters' second example ('Similarly') could fall below.

basic_cas_threshold_new.description: Basic CAS applicability threshold set by this final rule.

trigger_contract_amount.description: Contract amount of the trigger contract concept that this final rule eliminates.

full_coverage_threshold_old.description: Threshold for full CAS coverage and Disclosure Statement requirements before this final rule.

full_coverage_threshold_new.description: Threshold for full CAS coverage and Disclosure Statement requirements set by this final rule.
